answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the ferrous is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A zephyr of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wander of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, idle agents bleed standing.
